changes: 🔔 New: Chat Alerts — a genuinely new message now flashes the chat icon and plays a short chime, on top of the existing dot, since the dot alone was too easy to miss in a busy real-world environment. Toggleable off (e.g. at the footy) in the app footer.

📊 New: Syndy-run polls — "@Syndy poll: pizza or Thai" posts a real poll, voting straight through the existing reaction system (tap an option, live counts). Parsing is simple keyword-splitting, not an LLM call — reliable and free, won't perfectly handle very complex phrasing.

🔥 New: Roast on demand — "@Syndy roast Name" pulls their real season stats (win rate, P/L, average leg odds, worst and current losing streak) and builds a burn from whichever numbers are actually notable. Entirely client-side, no LLM call needed.

🤖 Syndy now knows how the app itself works — the Board, Casino, Tipping, Syndy's Book, Leg Bets, Acts of God, Group Chat — so she's a real first stop for "how does X work" questions, not just banter. syndy-chat.mjs updated, needs redeploying.
